_comment: AI-Search Hunter input (Goal League S1, owner aisearch). Read only by tools/build-aisearch.mjs, which writes: <title>, meta description, og:title and og:description for the slugs in pages{}; the AISEARCH:ANSWER block on /indices; and data/aisearch-llms.txt, which tools/build-llms.mjs puts into llms.txt only (llms-full.txt is untouched). Tokens in descriptions: {level} {date} {priced} {base}, filled from the page's ticker in data/indices.json. No eBay URLs, prices or asks here, ever (R45).

indices.title: Is the Pokémon Card Market Up or Down? Every Set's Price Index, Dated
indices.description: Is the Pokémon card market up or down? Each set we track is one number, re-marked from dated sold prices and set to 100 at a base month, with its week, month and 3-month move. Pokémon sets from Base Set to the 30th Celebration, plus the 2026 1st Bowman Chrome Auto indices. No buy or sell calls.

pokemon-base-set-index.title: Pokémon Base Set Card Prices (Unlimited): Dated Sold Prices · BS99
pokemon-base-set-index.description: Pokémon Base Set (Unlimited) card prices from dated sales of raw singles. The BS99 index stood at {level} on {date} (100 = {base}) across {priced} cards, re-marked Monday and Thursday. Every card is listed with its price and date.

pokemon-base-set-1st-edition-index.title: Pokémon Base Set 1st Edition Card Prices: Dated Sold Prices · BS1E
pokemon-base-set-1st-edition-index.description: Pokémon Base Set 1st Edition card prices from dated sales of raw singles. The BS1E index stood at {level} on {date} (100 = {base}) across {priced} cards, re-marked Monday and Thursday. Every card is listed with its price and date.

scarlet-violet-151-index.title: Pokémon 151 Card Prices: Scarlet & Violet 151 Dated Sold Prices · SV151
scarlet-violet-151-index.description: Pokémon 151 (Scarlet & Violet 151) card prices from dated sales. The SV151 index stood at {level} on {date} (100 = {base}, the release month) across {priced} cards, re-marked Monday and Thursday. Every card is listed with its price and date.
